text.aria-label: Caramelized Pear and Hazelnut Celebration Tart with Brown-Butter Custard
text.tspan: Caramelized Pear and Hazelnut Celebration Tart with Brown-Butter Custard

text.aria-label: Yield: one 28 cm tart serving ten to twelve people
text.tspan: Yield: one 28 cm tart serving ten to twelve people

text.aria-label: Position a rack in the lower third and preheat the oven without fan assistance
text.tspan: Position a rack in the lower third and preheat the oven without fan assistance

text.aria-label: Target: oven with rack in lower third
text.tspan: Target: oven with rack in lower third

text.aria-label: Temperature: 175 °C
Required by: bake until gently set
text.tspan: Required by: bake until gently set

text.aria-label: Note: Allow at least twenty minutes after the thermostat first signals readiness so the baking stone and oven walls reach an even temperature.
text.tspan: Note: Allow at least twenty minutes after the thermostat first signals readiness so the baking stone and oven walls reach an even temperature.

text.aria-label: Arrange the cooled pastry shell on a rimmed tray beside a heatproof landing area
text.tspan: Arrange the cooled pastry shell on a rimmed tray beside a heatproof landing area

text.aria-label: Target: stable work surface protected from hot caramel and splashing custard
text.tspan: Target: stable work surface protected from hot caramel and splashing custard

text.aria-label: Required by: arrange and pour
6 large ripe but still firm Conference pears, peeled, cored, and cut lengthwise into evenly sized eighths
text.tspan: 6 large ripe but still firm Conference pears,
peeled, cored, and cut lengthwise into evenly

text.aria-label: peeled, cored, and cut lengthwise into evenly sized eighths
text.tspan: peeled, cored, and cut lengthwise into evenly sized eighths

text.aria-label: 180 g unsalted cultured butter, cut into small equal cubes
text.tspan: 180 g unsalted cultured butter, cut into small

text.aria-label: cut into small equal cubes
240 mL heavy cream with at least thirty-five percent milk fat
text.tspan: 240 mL heavy cream with at least thirty-five

text.aria-label: 4 large free-range eggs at room temperature
text.tspan: 4 large free-range eggs at room temperature

text.aria-label: 175 g skinned roasted hazelnuts, very finely ground but not processed into nut butter
text.tspan: 175 g skinned roasted hazelnuts, very finely
ground but not processed into nut butter

text.aria-label: very finely ground but not processed into nut butter
text.tspan: very finely ground but not processed into nut butter

text.aria-label: 220 g superfine golden caster sugar
one 28 cm all-butter sweet pastry shell, blind-baked until deeply golden at the edges and completely cooled in its fluted tart pan
text.tspan: one 28 cm all-butter sweet pastry shell,
blind-baked until deeply golden at the edges and
completely cooled in its fluted tart pan

text.aria-label: completely cooled in its fluted tart pan
text.tspan: completely cooled in its fluted tart pan

text.aria-label: brown the butter slowly
Uses: 180 g unsalted cultured butter
Time: 8 to 12 min
Until the milk solids are a deep hazelnut brown and smell nutty without any black specks
Makes: fragrant brown butter with toasted milk solids
caramelize every pear surface
Uses: 6 large ripe but still firm Conference pears
Time: 12 to 15 min
Until each wedge is amber on two broad sides yet remains firm enough to lift intact
Makes: evenly caramelized pear wedges with intact edges
whisk a smooth hazelnut custard

Uses: 240 mL heavy cream with at least thirty-five percent milk fat · 4 large free-range eggs at room temperature · 175 g skinned roasted hazelnuts with no bitter papery fragments remaining · 220 g superfine golden caster sugar
Until no dry pockets remain and a ribbon drawn across the surface disappears slowly
Makes: pourable brown-butter and roasted-hazelnut custard
arrange and pour
Uses: one 28 cm shell all-butter sweet pastry shell, blind-baked until deeply golden at the edges
Until the pear fan remains visible and custard reaches every gap without overflowing the pastry rim
Makes: unbaked pear and hazelnut tart ready for careful transfer
bake until gently set
Temperature: 175 °C · Time: 35 to 45 min
Until the outer custard is set while the center retains a small coherent wobble when the tray is nudged
caramelized pear and hazelnut celebration tart with brown-butter custard
